body:
rtassita@emerald.tufts.edu (    Rafi) wrote:
> Dude, all you Unabomber fans are a bunch of wannabes.  How can you say 
> how great he is and agree with his anti-technology views by posting onto 
> the internet!!!

You are clearly not someone who read the Manifesto.  We are using
the Internet to communicate about the revolution and join forces
with other revolutionaries.

202.  It would be hopeless for revolutionaries to try to attack the 
      system without using SOME modern technology.  If nothing else
      they must use the communications media to spread their message.
      But they should use modern technology for only ONE purpose:
      to attack the technological system.

> This is exactly the kind of shit he is against (at 
> least that what it seems like to me)  If he could he would probably kill 
> all of you too.  If you really do believe in what he says why dont you 
> fight for it too.  Get off the fuckin internet throw away your TV's 
> Stereos and all and go live in a hut in the woods.  You can grow your own 
> food and walk around and...   do other non-technological things.  

Denial doesn't change the system.  FC showed that action causes change
while denial or "open-minded discussion" causes nothing to change.

> People talk about the unabomber being against threats to humanity.  Well 
> I think someone who goes around blowing people up is a bigger threat to 
> humanity, especially when he's got fans.  What is humanity coming to when 
> a murdering psycho (and he is a psycho: ex-Harvard prof gone hermit?!?!) 
> is revered??

Maybe it means that you don't understand the Manifesto and haven't
thought very clearly about what he and others are saying.  Why is someone 
a psycho if they choose to do something you wouldn't?  Why should everyone 
conform to your views or the views that you are conforming to?

-Ric
